components.css: .ds-button{min-height:54px;display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:14px 21px;border-radius:50%;font:700 12px/1.4 var(--sans,"DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif);letter-spacing:.035em;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .25s ease,background .25s ease,color .25s ease,border-color .25s ease;cursor:pointer}.ds-button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--caramel,#955f34);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-primary{color:var(--paper,#fffaf3);background:var(--cocoa,#3f2417);border:1px solid var(--cocoa,#3f2417)}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--cocoa-soft,#674531);border-color:var(--cocoa-soft,#674531)}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:translateY(-1px)}

components.css: .ds-text-link{min-height:54px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:14px 21px;border-radius:50%;color:var(--cocoa,#3f2417);border:1px solid var(--line,#d8c6af);font:700 12px/1.4 var(--sans,"DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif);letter-spacing:.035em;text-decoration:none;transition:color .25s ease,transform .25s ease}.ds-text-link:hover{color:var(--caramel,#955f34);transform:translateY(-3px)}.ds-text-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--caramel,#955f34);outline-offset:4px}.ds-text-link span{font-size:18px;font-weight:400;transition:transform .25s ease}.ds-text-link:hover span{transform:translate(3px,-2px)}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:18px 0;font-family:var(--sans,"DM Sans",Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-nav a{color:var(--cocoa,#3f2417);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.07em;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .2s ease}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--caramel,#955f34)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--caramel,#955f34);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-nav{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0;background:var(--cream,#f7f1e8);padding:20px}.ds-nav a{min-height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d8c6af);font-size:13px}}

narrative.overview: Editorial gastronômico acolhedor. Fotos reais permanecem protagonistas. A composição combina espaço generoso, tipografia serifada expressiva e detalhes finos inspirados na marca. Referência visual do usuário: página clara, produto em destaque e ornamentos discretos.
